name: All emergencies
note: One national number for police, fire and ambulance.

name: Police
note: Theft, trespass, public nuisance or any unsafe situation.

name: Fire
note: Also call the Security ASO so the gate can be opened immediately.

name: Ambulance
note: Free government ambulance service across Telangana.

name: LPG gas leak
note: Do not switch anything on or off. Open the windows and leave.

name: Security ASO
note: Night assistance, gate issues and emergency coordination.

name: Childline
note: Round-the-clock help for a child in distress.

name: Women’s helpline
note: Round-the-clock support and assistance for women.
